data.title: Experts urge Thailand to derive more value from rising investment
data.description: Experts at KT Dialogue urge Thailand to turn rising investment into stronger local supply chains, technology transfer and high-value manufacturing.

data.title: BOI pushes high-tech investment deeper into Thai supply chains
data.description: Thailand’s BOI reports a 27% rise in realised investment and is targeting high-tech industries to deepen domestic supply chains and skills.

data.title: US Inflation shifts focus to Jackson Hole, Nvidia lifts markets
data.description: Asian stocks rose after Nvidia beat forecasts, but persistent US inflation left investors awaiting Fed Chair Kevin Warsh’s Jackson Hole speech

data.title: Thailand Focus 2026 spotlights digital and New Economy investment
data.description: Thailand Focus 2026 brought 77 listed companies before global investors as the SET highlighted digital infrastructure and New Economy opportunities.

data.title: Thai MPC holds 1.00% policy rate while economic growth remains subdued
data.description: Merchandise exports and private investment linked to the technology and AI cycle are outperforming expectations, but their benefits to the Thai economy remain limited in scope.

data.title: Thailand advances high-speed rail amid Asia-wide expansion
data.description: Asia’s high-speed rail expansion gathers pace while Thailand accelerates the Bangkok–Nakhon Ratchasima line and targets a year-end decision on a shared section.

data.title: Cabinet backs wider SEC powers in capital-market overhaul
data.description: Four amendment bills would update electronic processes, secondary markets, fundraising and audit oversight, but still require parliamentary approval.

data.title: Finance Ministry weighs gold tax to trace grey capital flows
data.description: Thailand is studying a modest gold transaction tax to trace trades and curb money laundering, with industry consultations due soon

data.title: Bangkok office tenants put value ahead of CBD prestige
data.description: Knight Frank’s Q2 data show Bangkok tenants weighing cost and access as rents and occupancy diverge across CBD and non-CBD districts.

data.title: Gen Z fuels growth in fractional and digital gold investing
data.description: YLG says younger investors are entering the gold market earlier, using mobile platforms for smaller purchases and regular long-term accumulation

data.title: Gold hits three-month high as weaker dollar fuels rally
data.description: Spot gold climbs 2.4% to US$4,623.94 an ounce after breaking its 200-day moving average, with Treasury buyback plans weighing on the dollar

data.title: US Treasury buybacks may redirect capital towards Asia
data.description: Larger US Treasury bond buybacks briefly lowered long-term yields and the dollar, raising prospects of capital flows towards Asia and emerging markets

data.title: Thai banks face headwinds as ING cuts TTB stake and KBANK faces SME risks
data.description: ING’s reduced ttb stake and pressure on KBANK’s SME borrowers put Thai banks under scrutiny, although system capital and liquidity remain strong

data.title: ING cuts ttb stake to 11.6% through €475m PP share sale
data.description: ING will cut its ttb stake from 19.5% to 11.6% in a €475m institutional sale, while the Thai bank says management and strategy are unaffected

data.title: Foreign investors show growing interest in Bangkok and Phuket condos
data.description: CBRE figures show foreign buyers accounted for 32% of central Bangkok condominium purchases, while its transaction data put the share at 67% in Bang Tao and Cherng Talay.

data.title: Happitat Launch Ignites Retail Battle for Bangkok's East
data.description: CP Axtra's 15-billion-baht Happitat opens this week, sharpening competition with Bangkok Mall, Central and Bitec for Bangna's shoppers.

data.title: AWC launches 416-room Fairmont Bangkok with a focus on luxury MICE and wellness
data.description: AWC has opened Thailand’s first Fairmont hotel in Bangkok after investing more than THB6 billion, targeting international luxury MICE demand

data.title: New bad debts rise as high costs and weak demand strain Thai firms
data.description: New and re-entry NPLs totalled about THB110 billion in Q2, while SME lending contracted for a 16th straight quarter, according to the BOT.

data.title: Bangkok's New City Plan Set to Pull Property Buyers Back from the Suburbs, KKP Warns
data.description: KKP researchers say Bangkok's overdue city plan overhaul could trigger a "Pull-Back Effect", drawing buyers back from the suburbs

data.title: Retail and mixed-use boom pushes Siam land values to THB4m per square wah
data.description: Retail and mixed-use projects are reshaping Bangkok’s Siam Square and Pathum Wan, where land values have climbed to THB3.8–4 million per square wah.

data.title: Thai SEC expands checks on major shareholder funding
data.description: Thailand’s SEC has widened major-shareholder checks to significant funders, giving existing securities and digital asset firms 90 days to comply.

data.title: Thai gold traders to oppose possible tax in talks with Finance Ministry
data.description: Thailand’s Gold Traders Association plans to oppose a possible gold tax while seeking support for US dollar trading and regional gold-hub ambitions.

data.title: Foreign buyers turn to Thai property for high rental yields
data.description: Foreign demand is becoming more important to Thailand’s property market as domestic buying power weakens, with rental yields in Pattaya and Phuket reaching 8–10%.

data.title: AWC cuts Asiatique tower to 56 storeys in major Chao Phraya revamp
data.description: AWC has revised its Asiatique redevelopment on Bangkok’s Chao Phraya riverfront, cutting a tower to 56 storeys and adding the Blue Dome, a cable car and MONA Bangkok.

data.title: AWC Unveils THB 50bn REIT Plan for 2026 Listing
data.description: Asset World Corp plans to list a THB 50bn freehold REIT on the Thai bourse within 2026, seeding it with five projects from its 61-strong portfolio

data.title: Thailand pushes EAEU FTA in high-level Russia talks
data.description: Sihasak Phuangketkeow leads Thai officials and businesses in Moscow, seeking wider trade, investment and progress on a Thailand-EAEU FTA

data.title: Pluak Daeng becomes ‘Little Guangzhou’ as Rayong weighs tighter controls
data.description: Chinese investment is transforming Pluak Daeng in Rayong, lifting land prices while raising concerns over zoning, utilities and local businesses.

data.title: Bangkok hotels see higher occupancy with lower room rates and revenue
data.description: Bangkok’s occupancy rose while ADR and RevPAR fell in the first half of 2026; Phuket raised room rates despite declines in occupancy and air-traveller numbers.

data.title: Bank of Thailand Launches First Major Restructuring in 27 Years
data.description: Under Governor Vitai Ratanakorn, the Bank of Thailand launches three new divisions targeting non-banks, consumer protection, and digital payment systems

data.title: AWC invests 2.9bn baht in new Plaza Athénée hotel on Chao Phraya
data.description: AWC will invest 2.9 billion baht in a 146-room Plaza Athénée hotel, expanding its 11-destination Riverside Journey along the Chao Phraya.

data.title: New Wave of Industrial FDI and Tech Shift Offsets Domestic Housing Slump, Says Frasers Property Thailand
data.description: FPT's CEO says FDI in semiconductors and data infrastructure is offsetting a housing slump driven by record household debt

data.title: Thai property groups sell land to boost liquidity and cut costs
data.description: Property Perfect, Pruksa, Bangkok Land and BJC are offering land and assets worth more than THB20bn as developers prioritise cash flow and lower holding costs.

data.title: Gold hits seven-week high as US payrolls unexpectedly fall
data.description: Gold surged 2.3% as a surprise fall in US payrolls reduced expectations of a Federal Reserve rate rise and put bullion on course for a seven-month-best week

data.title: ASW Doubles Down on Location Strategy as Confidence in Property Demand Firms
data.description: AssetWise says demand remains resilient in well-located pockets of the market, backing a record Bt26.76bn in project handovers this year

data.title: Gold surges as weaker dollar and Hormuz hopes lift demand
data.description: Gold posted its strongest daily rise since February as falling US yields, a softer dollar and progress on a Hormuz shipping route supported prices

data.title: TBA Chairman Slams Social Media Trend Glorifying Loan Defaults
data.description: Payong Srivanich warns banks can distinguish hardship from wilful default, as virtual banking push aims to widen credit access for Thailand's underserved

data.title: CLICX suspends loan applications, warns against deliberate defaults
data.description: CLICX has temporarily halted loan applications after demand exceeded forecasts, while warning that deliberate defaults could damage borrowers’ credit records.

data.title: Thailand property market shaken by nominee crackdown on luxury homes
data.description: Thailand’s probe into nominee structures linked to foreign buyers has put 33 luxury homes worth 1.27 billion baht under scrutiny and raised market concerns
